text_blocks.snippet: To access your HELB (Higher Education Loans Board) funds, you can use either the *642# USSD code or the HELB mobile app. First, ensure your M-PESA number is registered under your name and ID. If using USSD, dial *642#, select login, enter your details, choose "withdraw funds," then "upkeep," and specify the amount. Confirm with your M-PESA PIN. Alternatively, the HELB mobile app allows you to register, log in, and withdraw funds as well.

list.snippet: *Dial 642#: This initiates the HELB USSD service.
Login: Select the login option and enter your details, likely including your ID number and PIN.
Withdraw Funds: Choose the "withdraw funds" option, then select "upkeep".
Specify Amount: Enter the amount of money you wish to withdraw.
Confirm with M-PESA PIN: You'll be prompted to enter your M-PESA PIN to finalize the transaction.
Confirmation: You'll receive a confirmation message from M-PESA upon successful withdrawal.
Download and Install: If you don't have it, download the HELB mobile app from the Google Play store.
Register/Login: Register your details or log in to your existing account.
Navigate to Withdraw: Find the option to withdraw funds, which may be under a section like "Loans" or "My Account".
Follow Instructions: The app will guide you through the withdrawal process, likely requiring you to select the amount and confirm with your M-PESA PIN.
Confirmation: You will receive a confirmation message upon successful withdrawal.
